description: Create a new launch configuration for Auto Scaling. Exactly one image source must be provided: serverImageProductCode, serverImageNo, or memberServerImageInstanceNo. A server spec is also required: serverImageProductCode → serverProductCode (XEN/RHV); serverImageNo / memberServerImageInstanceNo → serverSpecCode (KVM, see ncloud_get_server_specs). Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating

initScriptNo.description: Init script number to run on first boot

isEncryptedVolume.description: Whether to encrypt the root volume (RHV only)

launchConfigurationName.description: Launch configuration name (1-255 chars: lowercase letters, digits, '-'; auto-generated when omitted)

loginKeyName.description: Login key name for SSH access (defaults to the most recently created key)

memberServerImageInstanceNo.description: Member server image instance number — for a user-created server image. One of serverImageProductCode / serverImageNo / memberServerImageInstanceNo is required.

serverImageNo.description: Server image number — for a new (public) server image (required path for KVM/Gen3). One of serverImageProductCode / serverImageNo / memberServerImageInstanceNo is required.

serverImageProductCode.description: Server image product code — for a new (public) server image, RHV/XEN. One of serverImageProductCode / serverImageNo / memberServerImageInstanceNo is required.

serverProductCode.description: Server product (spec) code — pair with serverImageProductCode (XEN/RHV). One of serverProductCode / serverSpecCode is required (the API rejects a request without a spec).

serverSpecCode.description: Server spec code — pair with serverImageNo or memberServerImageInstanceNo (KVM/Gen3, e.g. c2-g3, s2-g3). One of serverProductCode / serverSpecCode is required (the API rejects a request without a spec).

name: ncloud_create_launch_config
